title: Measuring Personal Information Exposure in Mental Health-Related Conversations with LLMs
summary: LLM-generated mental-health conversations were evaluated for inference and exposure of sensitive profile attributes, quantifying privacy risk at conversation and profile levels.
ai_technology: LLMs generate conversations and perform attribute-inference evaluation against sampled profiles.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Synthetic conversations were compared with real-conversation characteristics and scored with explicit attribute-inference and exposure metrics; the study quantifies modeled privacy risk rather than real-world disclosure outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: LLMs generate conversations and perform attribute-inference evaluation against sampled profiles.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
